C1162.title: TikTok Fined €530 Million for Illegal Data Transfers
C1162.summary: In May 2025, the Irish Data Protection Commission ruled that TikTok illegally transferred European Economic Area user data to China, violating GDPR, and imposed a €530 million fine. The case highlights compliance risks for cross-border e-commerce platforms in cross-border data transfers.
